title: Design System: Queue Arcade LED board
scope: Describes the LED-board concept under design/poc/led-board/ only. The shipped Next.js app (CSS modules under src/components) is not covered.

display.purpose: Lobby headline only. Uppercase, balanced, max 16ch, emphasised phrase in amber.

headline.purpose: The question prompt. Uppercase, balanced, max 22ch, 1.9em minimum height.

clock.purpose: The shared countdown as 00:SS. Colour follows the State Colour Law.

title.purpose: Answer cell labels, one line with ellipsis. Action labels at weight 800 and 2rem.

state.purpose: The state line under the time bar and the hero status line. Uppercase.

body.purpose: Reading sentences only: verdict (64ch), pitch, scoreboard note. Sentence case.

label.purpose: Round label, ticker, search label, split heading. Items separated by 6px LED squares.

caption.purpose: Scoreboard captions, cell and action sub-lines. Uppercase.

numeral.purpose: Scoreboard stats, keycaps, percent readouts, inline counts. Always Doto.

extensions.elevation: None. Depth is three blacks: ground #101010, module #000000, ghost #1b1b1b. Two dot stencils (art-module screen door: 40% black dots on a 3px grid; verdict placeholder: ghost-2 dots on an 8px grid) add texture without light.

motion.name: swap
motion.purpose: The Instant Swap Rule. No element declares a transition; every state change is a one-frame class and colour swap.

motion.name: ticker-scroll
motion.value: ticker 48s linear infinite; translateX(0) to translateX(-50%); paused on hover
motion.purpose: The fascia ticker. The track is duplicated once for a seamless loop.

motion.name: ticker-stepped
motion.value: 4000ms interval, one item shown at a time
motion.purpose: Replaces the scroll under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: breaker-blink
motion.value: breaker 0.5s steps(1) infinite; 50% { background: #000; color: gold }
motion.purpose: The 2x crowd-breaker keycap at reveal. Removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: reveal-flash
motion.purpose: The Decisive Beat. Every fascia, module, and cell background becomes the result colour with black ink; the ground stays matte; the class is removed in one frame.

motion.name: fog-stage-3
motion.value: filter: blur(18px) saturate(0.35) contrast(0.6) brightness(0.7); transform: scale(1.12)
motion.purpose: Fogged Vision while more than 10 seconds remain.

motion.name: fog-stage-2
motion.value: filter: blur(9px) saturate(0.55) contrast(0.75) brightness(0.8); transform: scale(1.08)

motion.name: fog-stage-1
motion.value: filter: blur(4px) saturate(0.7) contrast(0.85) brightness(0.9); transform: scale(1.04)

motion.name: fog-stage-0
motion.purpose: Fogged Vision at reveal. Stages swap with no transition.

breakpoints.name: two-column
breakpoints.purpose: Board columns minmax(300px, 2fr) 3fr; answers 2x2; Play spans the actions row; Leave link on its own row; fog picker stacks.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Tokens change (seam 64px, cell 112px, fascia 84px, dot 3px, dot gap 1px). One column, 12px padding, 10px gaps, two-row fascia, Steam button hidden.

dimensions.name: seam-size
dimensions.purpose: Pitch of the ground's seam grid.

dimensions.name: dot
dimensions.purpose: One split-bar dot, one sign pixel, one ticket LED.

dimensions.name: cell-h
dimensions.purpose: Answer cell and lobby action height.

dimensions.name: fascia-h
dimensions.purpose: Fascia height. Two rows on mobile (52px + 32px).

dimensions.name: board-max
dimensions.purpose: Maximum board width, centred, with 24px padding.

dimensions.name: module-min-h
dimensions.purpose: Minimum height of the clock and question modules on desktop.

dimensions.name: timebar-cells
dimensions.purpose: Cells in the time bar; lit = round(seconds / total * 15).

dimensions.name: split-dots
dimensions.purpose: One dot per percent; lit count equals the percent.

dimensions.name: led
dimensions.purpose: LED square used as a label separator; 5px in the ticket.

dimensions.name: focus-ring
dimensions.purpose: Focus on every control; inset 0 on the search input.

browserSurfaces.scrollbar: 10px amber thumb on ghost track, scrollbar-width thin
browserSurfaces.link: amber, lit white on hover, no underline

narrative.overview:
The public room is one arena LED ribbon board. The page is a matte black floor ruled into 96px panels by faint seams. On the floor sit pure black LED modules: the clock, the question, four answer cells, and the scoreboard band. Everything that carries state is light. Words are condensed arena signage in capitals. Numbers are dot-matrix. Reading text is plain Barlow in sentence case.

Nothing fades, slides, or glows. A change of state is a one-frame swap, the way a scoreboard flips. The round has four phases (entry, answering, locked, reveal) and every element keeps its box through all four, so the player's eye never has to re-find the clock or the cells. At reveal the whole band drenches in the result colour for 700ms, then drops back to black with the result still lit.

The build rejects the dark dashboard of bordered cards with one glowing accent. It has no colour gradients, no glow halos, no shadows, no rounded corners, no transitions, and no borders used to show state.
keyCharacteristics: Matte ground, black modules, visible seams, zero radius.
One colour per state: amber live, white locked or waiting, green right, red wrong, white-gold only for the 2x crowd-breaker.
Unlit elements are drawn, not hidden: ghost dots at 16% opacity, unlit bar cells in ghost grey.
Dot-matrix numerals (Doto), signage capitals (Barlow Condensed), reading text (Barlow).
Every state change is instant. The only loops are the ticker scroll and the crowd-breaker blink.
Every phase-dependent element reserves its space. Nothing moves between entry, answering, locked, and reveal.

rules.name: The State Colour Law
rules.body: Amber is live answering. Lit white is locked, waiting, or missed. Green is right. Red is wrong. White-gold is the 2x crowd-breaker keycap and nothing else. A colour is never used as decoration.

rules.name: The Lit-or-Drawn Rule
rules.body: Every surface is either emitting light in one of the five colours or drawn unlit in a black or grey. There are no colour gradients, no glows, no translucent tints. A radial-gradient appears only as a dot stencil (the art module's screen-door overlay, the verdict placeholder field), never as a colour ramp.

rules.name: The Decisive Beat Rule
rules.body: The full band changes colour once per round, at reveal. The body takes flash-right, flash-wrong, or flash-missed for 700ms: every fascia, module, and cell background becomes the result colour (green, red, or lit white), all text and indicator cells become black, and images keep their pixels. The ground stays matte. The flash is then removed in one frame and the result colour stays only on the clock, the state line, and the result cells.

rules.name: The Signage Caps Rule
rules.body: Every heading, label, state line, and button label is Barlow Condensed in uppercase with tracking between 0.01em (display) and 0.14em (the sign). Sentence case is only for Barlow reading text.

rules.name: The Dot Readout Rule
rules.body: A readout is Doto: the clock, the round number, percentages, points, streaks, round counts, slot counts, the volume percent, and scored amounts inside the verdict. A digit that is part of a label or a signage line stays in the signage face, as in the answer label "2,250 gold" and the state line "Locked at 00:13".

rules.name: The Reserved Space Rule
rules.body: Nothing moves between entry, answering, locked, and reveal. Phase-dependent text has a minimum height (prompt 1.9em, state line 1.4em, verdict 3em on desktop and 6.75em under 720px). Phase-dependent content is hidden with visibility: hidden, never display: none, so its box stays. Cell footers and split rows have fixed heights. The verdict placeholder draws a field of ghost-2 dots on an 8px grid in the verdict's box while the round runs, then swaps to text at reveal.

rules.name: The Three Blacks Rule
rules.body: Ground, module, and ghost are the only depth. A surface never gets a shadow, a glow, a border, or a tint to lift it.

rules.name: The Instant Swap Rule
rules.body: No element has a transition. Every state change (phase, pick, lock, reveal, hover, fog stage) is a one-frame swap of class and colour. The only animations are the ticker scroll (48s linear loop, paused on hover), the crowd-breaker keycap blink (0.5s, steps(1)), and the 700ms reveal flash, which is a class added and removed by script. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the ticker stops scrolling and steps in place, the keycap blink is removed, and the flash remains as a single instant swap.

dos: Do set every readout (clock, percent, points, counts) in Doto with tabular numerals.
Do reserve the box for every phase-dependent element: minimum heights on text, fixed heights on footers and split rows, visibility: hidden for content that is not yet shown.
Do show state by fill: a picked cell fills amber, a right cell fills green, a wrong cell fills red, each with black ink and an inverted keycap.
Do draw unlit dots and cells rather than hiding them: 16% opacity for split dots, ghost-2 for bar cells.
Do separate modules by 12px of ground and join stats or rows with 1px seams.
Do keep the 2px amber focus ring with 2px offset on every control.
Do use a 6px LED square between label items in place of punctuation.
Do swap colour across the whole band once at reveal, for 700ms, and leave the ground matte.
donts: Don't add transitions, easing, fades, or slides. Every change is instant.
Don't use colour gradients, glows, blur halos, tints, or shadows. A radial gradient is only ever a dot stencil.
Don't use amber for anything that is not live. It is a state, not an accent.
Don't use breaker gold anywhere but the 2x crowd-breaker keycap.
Don't show state with a border. Fill the surface. Inset outlines are allowed only on image tiles where a fill would hide the art.
Don't let a phase change move, resize, or reflow anything on the board.
Don't set a heading, label, or button in sentence case or in Barlow. Signage is Barlow Condensed uppercase.
